editorial.blurb: This beloved Hawaiian spot serves up generous, delicious plates that keep people coming back—worth the drive.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early: they close before dinner and regulars sometimes miss out. The mixed chicken plate and grilled fish are customer favorites.

topDishes.note: Fabulous with flavourful gravy; comes with excellent macaroni salad and salad dressing
A reliable favorite with perfect portions
